methodology: 1008 fresh common bags = 84 full cycles of all six seats × two strong current-letter-price fields, Vickrey. Before last usable auction policies produce identical full bid/word traces. Candidate alone bids remaining confirmed cash only on positive immediate completion at remainingTiles=1; no future scoring tile exists and cash has zero terminal score. No idle/empirical opponents. Exact dictionary, floor score, affordability assertions and final-tile restriction. Idealized immediate client reactions.
monotonicityReason: Only the last usable auction changes; the following final award cannot be redeemed and unspent cash has zero terminal score. If a higher bid changes the winner, this bot acquires a tile enabling a positive legal word; if it already won, lower remaining cash cannot affect a later scoring auction. All existing words were flushed before this bid. This argument assumes the source endgame contract and enough final-auction network time to redeem the newly won tile.
